title: Reconnect openings with matched loops and non-redundant local SubD support
problem: A host surface must flow around a true opening without a detached ring, stretched radial quads, or redundant boundary controls that overconstrain the SubD result.

workflow: connected hard-surface or product shell around an opening

preconditions: Outer and opening loops have equal, deliberate point counts and correspondence.
The opening is a real boundary in one connected manufactured part, not a separate assembly.
The Subdivision modifier remains live and unapplied during diagnosis.
required_observations: Base all-quad/manifold health and evaluated topology.
Solid and reflective MatCap views of the perimeter, aperture, and transition zone.
Evaluated pinch-candidate count and normal-angle distribution before and after support changes.
action_policy: Reduce independently authored regions to a shared low resolution before reconnecting them.
Bridge corresponding outer-to-inner loops as one connected all-quad shell.
Add radial support loops locally near boundaries when one broad span loses the intended profile.
Do not combine support loops with crease or bevel by default; test each control separately and retain the least constrained version that passes silhouette and highlight review.
failure_predicates: Detached ring geometry substitutes for connected host topology.
Long radial quads visibly pull the opening or host silhouette.
Support plus crease increases pinching or highlight concentration without a required shape benefit.
Any n-gon, degenerate face, or non-manifold edge appears in the authored or evaluated shell.
recovery: Insert one or two authored radial support loops while preserving point correspondence.
Remove redundant crease control and reassess under MatCap.
If correspondence itself twists, reorder or rebuild the loops before adding density.

experiments.limitations: Bounded controller-like chapter artifact and rounded-panel transfer only; not a complete reference reconstruction.

version_scope: Verified in Blender 5.2.0 LTS with live unapplied Subdivision modifiers.
status_note: Transferred from a 16-point elongated controller shell to a 12-point offset rounded-rectangular aperture; two overconstrained variants retained as counterevidence.
